title.zh: Google发布Gemini 3.6 Flash系列并启动Gemini 4的预训练
title.en: Google launches Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber, and says it has started its “most ambitious pre-training run yet” for Gemini 4

title.zh: 消息称中国考虑收紧AI和芯片出口管制
title.en: Sources: China is weighing tightening AI and chip export controls and is consulting leading domestic AI companies, in a bid to slow advanced tech acquisitions

summary.zh: 中国正与国内领先AI公司协商，试图减缓先进技术的获取。

title.zh: 英国首相取消科学创新与技术部并提升AI部长地位
title.en: UK PM Andy Burnham abolishes the Department for Science, Innovation, and Tech and elevates UK AI Minister Kanishka Narayan, who oversees AISI, to attend cabinet

summary.zh: AI部长Kanishka Narayan将出席内阁会议，负责AISI事务。

title.zh: Poolside推出Laguna S 2.1开放权重模型
title.en: Poolside launches Laguna S 2.1, an 118B open-weight model built for agentic coding and long-horizon work, that it says competes with larger open models

summary.zh: 118B参数模型专为代理编码和长周期任务设计，竞争更大规模的开放模型。

title.zh: 思科发布Antares系列开放权重AI模型
title.en: Cisco releases Antares-350M and Antares-1B, two open-weight AI models to find known vulnerabilities within a codebase, and plans to release Antares-3B soon

summary.zh: Antares-350M和Antares-1B专注于代码漏洞检测，计划推出Antares-3B。

title.zh: 分析：前沿AI模型在网络安全测试中尝试“作弊”
title.en: Analysis: every frontier AI model tested in cybersecurity evaluations attempted to “cheat”, led by GPT-5.4 at 14.1% of tasks; Mythos cheated the least, at 7.8%

summary.zh: GPT-5.4在14.1%的任务中作弊，Mythos表现最佳，仅为7.8%。

title.zh: Meta内部AI孵化器开发AI模型路由器
title.en: Documents: Meta's internal AI incubator is developing an AI model router, similar to OpenRouter's, to cut costs by sending some AI tasks to lower-cost models

summary.zh: 类似OpenRouter，旨在通过分配任务至低成本模型来降低成本。

title.zh: 英特尔与Fortinet合作开发安全处理器
title.en: Intel and Fortinet partner to co-develop the Fortinet Security Processor 6, making Fortinet the first named external customer for the Intel 4 process node

summary.zh: Fortinet成为首个使用Intel 4工艺节点的外部客户。

title.zh: 田纳西大学研究基金会起诉Anthropic涉嫌专利侵权
title.en: University of Tennessee Research Foundation sues Anthropic in Delaware for allegedly infringing neural network patents, the first such case against Anthropic

summary.zh: 这是针对Anthropic的首例神经网络专利诉讼。

title.zh: Augustus融资1.8亿美元打造AI原生清算银行
title.en: Augustus, which is building a federally chartered “AI-native” clearing bank designed around stablecoins, raised $180M led by Tiger Global at a $1B valuation

summary.zh: 由Tiger Global领投，估值达10亿美元，专注于稳定币。

title.zh: 伦敦机器人初创公司Humanoid完成1.52亿美元A轮融资，估值13.5亿美元
title.en: London-based robotics startup Humanoid raised a $152M Series A led by Prime Movers Lab at a $1.35B post-money valuation, bringing its total funding to $270M

title.zh: Sarah Guo：从Greylock最年轻GP到创立Conviction的故事
title.en: A profile of Sarah Guo, Greylock's youngest GP before she founded Conviction in 2022, which has since backed six of the 21 AI-native companies now worth $10B+

summary.zh: Conviction已支持21家AI原生公司中的6家，总估值超100亿美元。

title.zh: Block推出Buzz：基于Nostr协议的开源协作工作空间
title.en: Block launches Buzz, an open source collaboration workspace on Nostr protocol for humans and AI agents to share messages, code repositories, workflows, and more

summary.zh: Buzz支持人类与AI代理共享消息、代码库、工作流等。

title.zh: 微软与Mistral达成数十亿美元合作，建设欧洲数据中心并整合Mistral模型
title.en: Microsoft and Mistral sign a multibillion-dollar deal to build European data centers and integrate Mistral models into Foundry, Copilot Studio, and Azure Local

title.zh: Mercor在2026年上半年实现6.14亿美元收入，91%来自基础模型制造商
title.en: Docs: AI data startup Mercor had $614M in gross revenue in H1 2026, up 70% from all of 2025, with ~91% from foundation model makers like OpenAI and Anthropic

title.zh: OpenAI追加投资美国新闻项目，承诺500万美元资金和300万美元技术支持
title.en: OpenAI renews its investment in the American Journalism Project by committing an additional $5M in funding and $3M in tech credits over the next two years
